features.title: Feature delivery scorecards
features.problem: Agent run records do not provide a joined feature-level QA and cost history.
features.delivered_behavior: Local deterministic feature scorecards join QA history and native run records, preserve failures and unknown costs, and reject stale acceptance or overwritten inputs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Stable findings and review rounds preserve rework history.
Unknown usage and duplicate settlements cannot inflate confidence or totals.
Independent review of exact implementation and meaningful tests.

features.title: Capped model comparison
features.problem: Cheaper build models have not been evaluated against Neuvetra-specific work.
features.delivered_behavior: Offline adapter independently accepted after one repair cycle; live comparison waits for secure OpenRouter credential.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pilot adapter preserves aggregate $5 budget including uncertain calls.
Two candidates receive equal synthetic screening and independent grading.
Results include actual provider usage, defects and limits.
